Date: 2026-09-28T09:14:00Z
Subject: Request: Vulnerability management evidence & SBOM — Oxford Health

Hi Alex,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our procurement security review we need a concise package covering Redwood's vulnerability management program. High-level asks below — can you confirm you can provide these by COB UK time on Thursday (2026-09-30)?

1) SAST/DAST: latest summary reports (last 12 months), remediation rates and average time-to-fix by severity.
2) Patch management SLAs: definition of critical/important/normal, patching windows and historical compliance stats.
3) Pen test executive summary: scope, findings, remediation status (redacted PII OK).
4) SBOM: machine-readable SBOM (CSV/JSON) for the inference service we evaluated (runtime image + deps), plus cadence for SBOM updates.
5) Evidence links: any verification artifacts (signed attestations, penetration-test certificates, SOC references).

We are largely focusing on production inference endpoints (hosted API + dedicated pools). If you have a short cover letter describing your vulnerability triage flow and owner responsibilities that would be helpful.

Best,
Tom

--
Tom Ellis
Head of Security Engineering
Oxford Health

Tom — attaching the package we discussed and linking the Drive folder below. Summary of what is included:

- redwood_sbom_2026-09-29.csv (machine-readable SBOM for the inference runtime image; includes transitive deps and SPDX tags; signed SHA256 manifest included in folder).
- sest-sast-report (sast-report-oxford-2026-09.zip) — aggregated SAST findings (Jan 2025 -> Sep 2026), counts by severity, avg time-to-fix, and remediation rate.
- dast-summary.csv — top DAST findings for hosted endpoints, with status and TTR.
- pentest_exec_summary_2026-06.pdf — June external engagement: scope, methodology, top findings (redacted), and remediation closure status (12/14 closed, 2 in remediation).
- remediation-compliance.xlsx — our measured SLA compliance for the past 12 months (Critical: 98% within 72h, High: 92% within 7d).

Short cover letter (excerpt):
"Redwood's vulnerability triage is owned by the Runtime Security team with a well-defined escalation matrix. Incoming findings are categorized automatically (SAST/DAST/pentest/runtime telemetry) and triaged by severity. Critical issues trigger a Kubernetes-based emergency patch workflow with a target remediate-and-deploy in 72 hours; remediation verification is automated via CI checks and runtime canary observations. We publish SBOM snapshots per release (typically daily snapshots during release windows) and maintain a signed manifest for auditability."
